description: Turn any photo into a black-and-white coloring page using real Sobel edge detection — print and color it in.

faqs.a: The photo is converted to grayscale, then a Sobel filter finds edges (rapid brightness changes). Pixels above your threshold become black lines on white — like a coloring book.
faqs.q: How does it make a coloring page?

faqs.a: Lower the threshold to keep more detail (more lines), raise it for a simpler page with bold outlines.
faqs.q: The page is too detailed / too plain — how do I fix it?

faqs.a: Yes — edge detection runs on your photo's pixels in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Choose a photo (bold, simple subjects work best).
Drag the detail threshold until the outlines look right.
Optionally invert for white lines on black.
Click "Download coloring page" to save the PNG.
title: Coloring Page Maker
